name: Tingkaopu
tagline: Find useful AI tools by task.
description:
Tingkaopu helps people find useful AI tools by the task they want to get done, with clear information about pricing and availability in China.

Watch out: the homepage opened on 2026-11-14 is a Chinese and English directory that recommends AI tools by task. The visible heading said it lists a first choice and a backup for 28 common tasks, with pricing and whether a tool can be used directly in China. It is a directory, not a generator. The same page groups tasks such as cutouts, posters, video, voiceover, and turning a meeting recording into notes. English and Japanese are in the language switch next to Chinese.
